customManagers.description: Every version Renovate cannot find by itself carries a `# renovate:` line directly above it: Talos and Kubernetes in talos/talenv.yaml, the Flux operator charts, their image digests, Flux and Headscale in infra/, chart image digests in kubernetes/, hcloud-upload-image in scripts/build-talos-snapshot.sh. A value written as tag@sha256:digest has both parts updated. One manager reads them all, so a version without the line is the only way to freeze silently.

The FluxInstance names its manifests artifact as one OCI reference, `artifact: oci://<image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>`, which the `# renovate:` manager above would read from the first colon. This reads the image, tag and digest from the reference itself.

Step-level composite actions pinned by commit with the full Forgejo URL, `uses: https://forgejo.webgrip.dev/webgrip/<repo>/<path>@<40 hex> # vX.Y.Z`. The forgejo preset's digest manager expects the shorthand without the host, and its tag manager only the bare tag, so this form would freeze. gitea-tags resolves the tag to its commit, so the digest and the comment move together.

The metal node's installer in talos/metal-image.yaml, published by webgrip/talos-kata-extension to the private webgrip-talos registry. The tag carries the Talos version as compatibility, so a bump stays on the Talos release talos/talenv.yaml pins; the digest moves with it. All zeros is the placeholder before the first release.

The metal node's disk image in talos/metal-image.yaml, published by webgrip/talos-kata-extension to the private webgrip-talos registry. The tag carries the Talos version as compatibility, so a bump stays on the Talos release talos/talenv.yaml pins; the digest moves with it. All zeros is the placeholder before the first release.

packageRules.description: A Talos or Kubernetes bump changes the machine configs OpenTofu applies, but the nodes only move with a rolling upgrade. Approve it on the dashboard when the upgrade is planned.

The Flux operator chart, its image and the manifests artifact are released together and must move together. Flux itself moves with them: the operator only installs a Flux version that the pinned manifests artifact contains.
prBodyNotes: `spec.distribution.version` in `kubernetes/platform/flux-instance/fluxinstance.yaml` must be a directory under `flux/` in the pinned `flux-operator-manifests` artifact, or the FluxInstance stops reconciling. A Flux release newer than the artifact waits for the next operator release. Flux upgrades the operator and Flux itself on merge; the Talos seed reads the same files and moves with the next `infra` apply.

packageRules.description: The cloud controller's image is pinned by digest beside its chart, so the two move in one PR.
prBodyNotes: Flux upgrades the running cloud controller on merge. The Talos seed reads the same files and moves with the next `infra` apply.

packageRules.description: The CSI driver and its sidecars are pinned by digest beside the chart, so they move in one PR.
prBodyNotes: Keep each sidecar on the tag the new chart's `values.yaml` ships unless its release notes say the chart's RBAC and flags still fit.

packageRules.description: Zot's image is pinned by digest beside its chart, so the two move in one PR.
The cluster-autoscaler chart and its image, pinned by digest, move in one PR. The image's minor version follows the cluster's Kubernetes minor (talos/talenv.yaml), never ahead of it.
prBodyNotes: Check that the image's minor version is not newer than the Kubernetes version in `talos/talenv.yaml`. Flux restarts the autoscaler on merge; a new or removed provider setting belongs in `infra/ci-autoscaler.tf` and reaches the cluster with the next `infra` apply.

packageRules.description: A Cilium minor or major release changes the network every pod depends on. Approve it on the dashboard and apply it in a maintenance window.
prBodyNotes: Flux upgrades the running Cilium on merge. The Talos seed reads the same files and moves with the next `infra` apply.

packageRules.description: Headscale is installed once by cloud-init, which ignores later changes; a bump records the version and its checksum must be updated with it. Upgrade the server by hand from the release notes.
prBodyNotes: Update `headscale_sha256` in `infra/headscale.tf` from the release's `checksums.txt`, then upgrade the running server by hand.

packageRules.description: hcloud-upload-image is installed from pinned checksums, which Renovate cannot update. Approve on the dashboard and update the checksums in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Update the three `upload_tool_sha256_*` values in `scripts/build-talos-snapshot.sh` from the release's `hcloud-upload-image_<version>_checksums.txt`.

packageRules.description: talosctl and kubectl for the diagnose run are installed from pinned checksums in scripts/diagnose-cluster.sh, which Renovate cannot update. talosctl moves with the Talos bump, which already waits for approval; kubectl waits for approval too.
prBodyNotes: Update the `talosctl_sha256_linux_*` values in `scripts/diagnose-cluster.sh` from the Talos release's `sha256sum.txt`, and the `kubectl_sha256_linux_*` values from `https://dl.k8s.io/release/<version>/bin/linux/<arch>/kubectl.sha256`.

packageRules.description: kube-apiserver, kubectl and etcd for the admission-policy fixtures are installed from pinned checksums in scripts/test-admission-policies.sh, which Renovate cannot update. Kubernetes should match the cluster's version, so both wait for approval.
prBodyNotes: Update `kube_apiserver_sha256_linux_amd64` and `kubectl_sha256_linux_amd64` from `https://dl.k8s.io/<version>/bin/linux/amd64/<binary>.sha256`, or `etcd_sha256_linux_amd64` from the etcd release's `SHA256SUMS`.

packageRules.description: required_version constrains OpenTofu, which Renovate would otherwise look up as Terraform. OpenTofu itself comes with the infra-runner image from webgrip/infrastructure, where it is pinned and updated.

The metal node's installer and disk image come from one talos-kata-extension release and must move together; scripts/check-metal-image.sh refuses a pin that mixes releases. Merging the pull request changes nothing until the next reviewed infra apply: a node that runs Talos upgrades with the installer, and only a metal server without Talos is installed from the disk image.
